'''Orvum Stadium''' was a building located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was made unique from other such buildings by the fact that each of its hundred upon thousands of seat could be adjusted to accommodate the needs of over a hundred different species. The [[Protorion Polygon]] was located nearby.
